description_expanded:
This beautiful, newly constructed home includes a first-floor primary bedroom with a king-sized bed. You will find the other two bedrooms on the second floor along with the washer and dryer. The second-floor bedrooms, one with a king-sized bed, and the other with two queen-sized beds offer private bathrooms. Just off the large living room and kitchen, you will find a spacious courtyard with a private non-heated plunge pool and a covered terrace. The covered terrace features a built-in grill and outdoor seating with a TV. Parking for this home is located in the two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 50 North Sea Garden Street. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
